name: Paragraphs Extended Modal
description: provides a more user-friendly Paragraphs add-modal experience.
project_description:
This module enhances the add paragraphs modal.

Making it possible to categorize paragraph types and providing a better layout in the modal when adding new paragraphs.

 Features 
 
 Install the module 
 Navigate to a content entity that has paragraphs with a widget that has the modal add method 
 
 Mentions 
 This module is heavily inspired by the Paragraphs Editor Enhancements module.

The goal was to have a similar module, but lighter in functionality. Code of that module has been used as a base for this one.
